priorityList: Use Multi-Shot if the Trick Shots buff is missing to enable your AoE cleave.
Use Trueshot as your primary offensive cooldown.
Cast Volley on cooldown to trigger Trick Shots and deal burst damage.
Use Multi-Shot to spend Precise Shots stacks to benefit from AoE cleave.
Cast Rapid Fire while Trick Shots is active, prioritizing it if Bulletstorm is about to expire or you have an Unload proc.
Cast Aimed Shot only while the Trick Shots buff is active to ensure it hits multiple targets.
Cast Wailing Arrow on cooldown for significant AoE damage.
Cast Rapid Fire as a priority filler whenever Trick Shots is active.
Use Steady Shot if you need to generate Focus or have no other abilities available.
Use offensive trinkets during Trueshot, specifically when the buff has more than 14 seconds remaining.
Use racial combat buffs (like Berserking or Blood Fury) while Trueshot is active.
Apply Power Infusion if Trueshot has more than 12 seconds of duration remaining.
Use an offensive potion during Trueshot if Bloodlust is active or the fight is ending soon.
Summon your pet before combat if you have the Unbreakable Bond talent.
